The '''High Priest of the Imperial Cult''' was the senior religious office of the [[Imperial Cult]] in the [[Vesperan Empire]]. The office connected the religious hierarchy of the cult to the emperor, the [[Imperial Council]], and the major ceremonial institutions of the imperial capital.

The high priest presided over major ceremonies at the [[Great Temple of Vespera]], including the [[Imperial Coronation Ceremony]], and supervised the priestly hierarchy associated with imperial rites.

This is a bridge draft. The individual officeholders, succession rules, and relationship with the imperial family need fuller source-backed development before publication.
